mechanism: Prednisolone may increase perphenazine metabolism via CYP450 enzyme induction while also increasing risk of hyperglycemia and immunosuppression; perphenazine may lower seizure threshold which corticosteroids can also affect.
action: Monitor blood glucose, mental status changes, and seizure risk; consider dose adjustments if perphenazine efficacy decreases; ensure adequate infection monitoring due to combined immunosuppressive effects.
